messages:
sophia-ng: hey team — opening bring-up thread for nova-13b-derived model (draft weights) arriving today. need quick quant plan + smoke evals. priority: cost-sensitive production route. target: 2-3x token cost reduction w/ <2% QA delta on eval suite. any objections to int8-first then fp8 fallback? :eyes:

mike-chen: int8-first seems reasonable. want to run FP32 baseline + 8-bit symmetric and asymmetric int8. we should capture logits / nll on eval set.

arjun_k: +1. calibration set size? recommended 2-4k examples from our long-tail prompts.

sophia-ng: suggest 3k from prod prompts + 1k adversarial. we'll store in /datasets/quant/nova13b/calib-v1

eva-lu: ps — gguf packaging for downstream offline nodes. Plan: pipeline -> int8 static calib -> gguf export with per-channel scales -> smoke runs. If int8 drop >2% then fp8 hybrid fallback.

mike-chen: estimate perf: int8 should give ~2.8x throughput on A10s, fp8 hybrid ~3.5x but more frag. Also memory drop numbers: int8 ~40% memory, fp8 ~55% memory.

arjun_k: important: collect both MBR and exact-match metrics. Also logits correlation (spearman) vs FP32.

sophia-ng: checklist proposal:
- baseline eval (FP32) on evalset (1000 prompt subset)
- calibration run (3k examples) for int8 symmetric & per-channel
- export gguf/int8 and run smoke (latency & quality)
- fallback run with fp8 hybrid if int8 fails
- cost model: token/unit cost estimate + infra perf numbers
- roll criteria doc

mike-chen: commands I'll run:
```
python evals/run_eval.py --model /mnt/models/nova13b/fp32 --prompts evalset/1000.json --out fp32.json
python quant/quant_calibrate.py --model /mnt/models/nova13b/fp32 --calib /datasets/quant/nova13b/calib-v1/3k.json --mode int8 --out /runs/calib_int8.json
python checkout/export_gguf.py --model /mnt/models/nova13b/fp32 --quant /runs/calib_int8.json --format gguf --out /exports/nova13b-int8.gguf
```

calib-bot: calibration job queued: job_id=cal-1765-01, ETA 2h :gear:

eva-lu: tagging owners: @mike-chen for runs, @arjun_k for metrics, @sophia-ng for rollout decision.

mike-chen: quick note — include "length-aware" calibration (sample lengths 16/128/512 split). otherwise int8 fails on long context.

arjun_k: Also add a small adversarial eval set for instruction-following failures (10 seeds).

sophia-ng: ok I'll assemble eval subsets + schedule a 4pm sync today. If int8 passes, we target canary on dedicated next week.

mike-chen: ack. starting FP32 baseline now.

calib-bot: job cal-1765-01 finished: status=success, duration=1h47m, artifacts=/jobs/cal-1765-01/artifacts

mike-chen: got baseline numbers: perplexity=7.9, mean-bleu=0.73, nll mean=2.05. uploading fp32.json

arjun_k: good. once calibration outputs are in I'll run logits-corr and mbr diffs.

eva-lu: reminder: capture token-level cost breakdown in console (route: dedicated/gpu-a10) and record tail latency p95/p99.

sophia-ng: thanks all. post results here and we can decide int8 vs fp8. :partyparrot:
